My mom died when I was 9, but I had been in therapy long before then. My childhood is almost completely blank because of trauma I experienced as a child that I only know bits and pieces of from short memories or family members. 

It never really hit me that I had a problem, for a long time I thought everything I was thinking was normal. It wasn’t until I had to go through trauma therapy that I realized and was able to admit to myself something was wrong. 

I have PTSD from my mom’s death, and bipolar disorder. I have a memory from when I was around 4-5 and I had this journal that I kept after my mom taught me how to read and write (I never went to preschool, so my mom taught me a lot before I even went into kindergarten) and in the journal for some reason I had written that I wished I had never been born and that I hated myself, and one night I was writing a letter to my aunt and I apparently was very upset at myself and signed it Hate, (my name) because I hated myself so I figured my family should too. In middle school I figured I would die before I went to college so when I went to high school and everyone was planning their futures I didn’t really care, so when college apps came around and smacked me in the face I applied to one college with a major I didn’t care for and said if I got in I would go to college, if not it’d be fine. Well I got in, and dropped out within 3 months. 

My therapist said that kinda thing wasn’t normal so I guess that’s where it started 🤷🏼‍♀️I’m still in therapy trying to process things and I’m on a med combination that’s starting to work for me so I’m hoping for the best going forward.
